    @allure.title("Water Target min/max limits validation")
    @allure.description("Test that water target respects min/max limits: oz (1-500) and ml (1-14787).")
    def test_23_water_target_min_max_limits(self):
        """Test water target min/max limits based on unit."""
        page = self.set_targets_page
    
        # Get unit configuration
        config = page.get_water_unit_config()
        unit = config["unit"]
        increment = config["increment"]
        max_value = config["max_value"]
        min_value = config["min_value"]
    
        # Test minimum limit - try to decrement below min
